capabilities: Applies one of six layout presets to a note
Previews the styled article at phone and iPad widths
Copies styled HTML with embedded images to the clipboard
Exports a standalone HTML file with its images
Saves a default preset and Markdown sign-off
disambiguation: Not an Obsidian theme or CSS snippet; it styles note content for pasting into the WeChat editor.
extras: Desktop only, requires Obsidian 1.15.0 or later. Formatting, vault image processing and HTML export run locally; remote images are fetched from their original hosts. Embedded notes, blocks, PDFs, audio, video and Canvas files must be converted to text or images before publishing.
problem: Notes pasted into the WeChat editor arrive unstyled and without their images, and styling each article by hand is slow.

relations.evidence: Copy body to paste the styled text and images into WeChat

summary: Desktop plugin that styles a note with one of six WeChat Official Account presets and copies the formatted text and images to the clipboard.
